learning_outcomes.text: Understand the importance of R&D&I in the current market from an economic and strategic perspective.
Develop strategic R&D&I plans for companies or organizations, including the selection of organizational structures necessary for their success.
Conceive, design and implement R&D&I projects in all their phases, from idea generation to result exploitation.

syllabus_topics: Strategic plans and organization for innovation.
R&D&I project management: proposal, work plan.
Exploitation of innovation: spin-offs, technology-based companies, etc. Internationalization.
assessment_rules: The 'Trabajos' component is calculated as the average of T1, T2, T3, and T4, each weighted 25%. If all minimums are met, the final grade is 80% 'Trabajos' and 20% 'EX'. A minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for both 'Trabajos' and 'EX'. Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. The extraordinary and differentiated evaluations follow the same system.
